title: The Unconditional Proof of the Inescapable Form of the Riemann Hypothesis: One Seat, Proved Unconditionally to Be the Hypothesis on Seven Faces, and Every Proof, Past or Future, Subsumed by Theorem, with Priority of Record: One Bit, Necessary and Sufficient, the Whole Proved from It by the Act, the Mirror from the Primes, and Alpöge's Certified Corpus Carried Inside the Seat by Theorem

title: Three Ledgers on Yang–Mills: Who Shows the Work
date_evidence: Owner view (Table C): Added 2026-11-12

title: The Arrow of Time as a Theorem: Transforming the Second Law of Thermodynamics from Law to Theorem on Reversible Dynamics
date_evidence: Owner view (Table C): Added 2026-11-06
abstract_snippet: Since Loschmidt the arrow of time has posed one question: how can microscopic dynamics that run equally well backwards produce a law that runs one way? The Second Law of Thermodynamics has stood as a law, not a theorem, because every derivation from reversible mechanics needed a premise to close that gap. This paper transforms it into a theorem.

title: Dark Matter as the Charge-Conjugation Fixed Set and the Dark Force as One Keyed Bit: A Trisductive Theory of Dark Matter and the Dark Force: Why Only the Fourth Reading Sees It
date_evidence: Owner view (Table C): one of the eleven theorem papers added 2026-11-25

A state is four charges, hypercharge, weak isospin, colour and a dark charge, and a mass.

title: Immanent Gravity as a Machine-Checked Mathematical Theorem: Einstein's Equation Forced by Conservation, Newton's as Its Half-Reading, and Four Dimensions Singled Out
date_evidence: Owner view (Table A): First archival date 2026-11-25; V1 uploaded 11/25 07:31:49 GMT, V2 11/25 09:40:26 GMT
abstract_snippet: This paper proves, in Lean 4 with Mathlib, that conservation forces the law of gravity... The main theorem then states: if a law a Ric + b R g + c g has no divergence on every geometry, then a + 2b = 0, so the law is Einstein's with a free vacuum term... Newton's equation is the time reading, and the potential of space obeys the same equation.

title: Light as a New Mathematical Theorem: Maxwell's Equations Forced by the Conservation of Charge, Coulomb's Law as Their Half-Reading, and Two Helicities with No Third
date_evidence: Record page: Archival date 2026-11-25; Added to PP 2026-11-25 ('yesterday' at crawl 2026-11-26)
abstract_snippet: This paper proves, in Lean 4 with Mathlib, that the conservation of charge forces Maxwell's equations: the forced law has b = -a and photon mass zero, its waves are transverse with two helicities and no third, and its static reading is the inverse square.

title: Matter as a New Mathematical Theorem: Exclusion Forced by the Full Turn, the Dirac Equation as the Least Law of a Half-Spin, and Two Statistics with No Third in Three Dimensions
date_evidence: Record page: First archival date 2026-11-25; Latest version 2 (2026-11-25)
abstract_snippet: This paper proves, in Lean 4 with Mathlib, that a law of first order whose square is the mass shell is the Dirac law, and that the exchange of two of its particles excludes. The main theorem: if the operator of first order squares to the mass shell at every momentum, its coefficients obey the Clifford relations.

title: Quantum Correlation as a New Mathematical Theorem: No Signal Forced by the Registration, Bell's Bound as the Whole Reach of Local Records, and the Outcome as One Keyed Bit
date_evidence: Record page: Archival date 2026-11-25
abstract_snippet: This paper proves, in Lean 4 with Mathlib, three statements about the records of two separated parties: no signal is forced by the registration; Bell's bound of two is the whole reach of local records; and the quantum reach is Tsirelson's bound, by Landau's identity.

title: The Arrow Has Two Branches: Magnetism and Gravity as the Priced and the Reversible Registration of One Arrow
date_evidence: Public /versions page: V1 uploaded 2026-11-25 10:28:18 GMT (only version)
abstract_snippet: This paper proves, in Lean 4 with Mathlib, that one arrow has two branches: a branch that keeps a record and is a map of two states onto one, and a branch that keeps none and is a bijection. The first is a magnet... The second branch is motion under a potential in any real inner product space: the energy is constant, the path run backwards with the velocity turned is again a motion, the force does no work round a closed path, and under a central force the area rate is constant.

title: The Charges of Matter as a New Mathematical Theorem: Why the Lepton Charges Follow from the Quark Charges: Closure of the Record in Every Generation, and No Charge That No Field Reads
date_evidence: Public /versions page: V1 uploaded 2026-11-25 09:46:56 GMT (only version)
abstract_snippet: This paper proves, in Lean 4 with Mathlib, that four sums fix the charges of a generation of matter. Four sums of the five hypercharges of a generation, three of first degree and one of third, must vanish for the readings of the weak field, of the strong field, of gravity and of the hypercharge field itself to be consistent.

title: Three Dimensions of Space as a New Mathematical Theorem: Weight, Waves, Light Bent Twice, Stable Orbits and Two Statistics Hold Together in Three Dimensions and in No Other
date_evidence: Public /versions page: V1 uploaded 2026-11-25 09:07:33 GMT; record page: Archival date 2026-11-25
abstract_snippet: This paper proves, in Lean 4 with Mathlib, that five properties of the laws of gravity, light and matter - weight, waves, space and time curved alike, a stable orbit, and two statistics - hold together exactly when the dimension of space is three, and in no other.

title: The Fine-Structure Constant as a New Mathematical Theorem: Why No Formula Returns 137: One Coupling, Universal and Positive, Whose Value the Law Cannot Fix
date_evidence: Record page: Archival date 2026-11-25
abstract_snippet: This paper proves, in Lean 4 with Mathlib, that the forced law of light leaves the value of its coupling open, and proves what it does fix. For every positive number the structure has a member whose coupling is that number, so there is no number that the coupling equals in every member: no formula returns 137.

title: The Nuclear Forces as a New Mathematical Theorem: The Yang-Mills Equations Forced by a Charge That Does Not Commute, Maxwell's Equations as Their Commuting Half, and Three Generations as the Least with One Phase
date_evidence: Record page: First archival date 2026-11-25; Latest version 2 (2026-11-25)
abstract_snippet: This paper proves, in Lean 4 with Mathlib, that a charge that does not commute forces the Yang-Mills strength. The charge is a Lie algebra, matter is a module over it, the potential is a family of charges, and the derivatives are derivations that commute.

title: The Record as a New Mathematical Theorem: Why a Horizon Only Grows, Why No Path Returns, and Why Nothing Is Lost: The Step Law and the One Sign Proved for Every Sequence of Registrations
date_evidence: Record page: Archival date 2026-11-25
abstract_snippet: This paper proves, in Lean 4 with Mathlib, that the record of a sequence of registrations changes only by what is registered and never decreases, for every such sequence. For every history, no act raises the number of states told apart, which is the one sign.
